4 4 4 7 7 4 4 7 7 7 7 7 7 3 3
4 4 4 7 7 4 4 7 7 0 7 7 7 7 7
4 4 7 7 7 7 4 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7'''
grid=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in s.splitlines()])
# 4-components for 4, others (same color)
def comps(color, region=None):
 a=grid if region is None else grid[:,region]
 seen=set(); out=[]
 for y,x in zip(*np.where(a==color)):
  if (y,x) in seen: continue
  st=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); c=[]
  while st:
   p=st.pop(); c.append(p)
   for q in [(p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)]:
    yy,xx=q
    if 0<=yy<a.shape[0] and 0<=xx<a.shape[1] and a[yy,xx]==color and q not in seen: seen.add(q);st.append(q)
  ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
  out.append((len(c),(min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)),c))
 return out
print([(n,b) for n,b,c in comps(4, slice(0,7))])
for col in [1,2,3,6,8]: print(col,[(n,b) for n,b,c in comps(col)])
